snippet.title: Amelia Watson Case File no.420 🔎 (hololive fangame visual novel)
snippet.description:
➡️ https://planetdropper.itch.io/ame420

Finding the answer is about asking the right question.

AME420 is a short #holoMyth fan visual novel about an ace detective investigating a certain phoenix's trashy death.
